summary: This directory provides mechanism for implementing retry logic when interacting with external providers. It focuses on ensuring reliability and fault tolerance by wrapping operations that may fail temporarily.
responsibilities: Execute operations with configurable retry strategies
Manage failure scenarios for provider interactions
Ensure consistent execution behavior during intermittent errors
relationships: The retry mechanism wraps provider operations to handle transient failures gracefully.
designDecisions: Decorator-like wrapping pattern to encapsulate retry logic
Configuration-based approach for handling operation attempts
